evidence.supports: Relato congelado, cargas, pausa, transformación y contraste entre mercancía y agua.
evidence.limits: Búsqueda en ranchería, viajeros Wayuu, desorientación y panela petrificada son ampliaciones editoriales, no detalles literales del breve registro.

evidence.supports: Dos comerciantes con panela se detienen por sed/cansancio en Utta cerca de Katetamana y se vuelven piedra.
evidence.limits: No fija nombres, raza, vestuario, embalaje ni transporte. No reproducir esencialismo racial del comentario del recopilador.

evidence.supports: Seis modelos aprobados diferenciados y límites de la fuente.
evidence.limits: Prendas, colores y siluetas son decisiones editoriales, no retratos documentales.

bible_overrides.decision: Conservar bigote, camisa ocre, pantalón carbón y sombrero ancho; rostro de recorte plano en vez de anatomía facetada.
Conservar camisa azul, tirantes oscuros, pantalón terracota y gorra arena; evitar aspecto caricaturesco.
No copiar franjas alternas como patrón cultural, bases circulares ni monumentos. Mantener dos formas distintas en terreno continuo.
Dos bultos en la escena; una panela única en símbolo. Embalaje liso sólo como decisión de puesta en escena.

narrative_contract.summary: Dos comerciantes forasteros cruzan Utta con panela, se detienen por sed y cansancio, y quedan ligados a formas de piedra. Las imágenes narran la carga y la transformación, y condensan el contraste entre mercancía y agua. No hay una deidad visible, uniformes étnicos ni celebración de daño.

events.action: Dos comerciantes llevan panela y se detienen por sed/cansancio.
Ambos quedan convertidos en piedra en Utta.
La edición contrapone valor de la panela y necesidad de agua.

narrative_contract.emotional_reading: Vulnerabilidad y límite, sin burla, superioridad racial ni castigo espectacular.
narrative_contract.magic_reading: El peso del comercio y la ausencia de agua quedan inscritos en la materia.
narrative_contract.qa_method: Dos comerciantes diferenciados; H carga y sombras imposibles de vasijas; V ropa conectada al terreno como transformación sin dolor; S una panela y vacío, no escena.

retained: Estratos de papel y contraste entre amarillos/ocres cálidos y azules fríos.
Dos figuras diferenciadas vinculadas al paisaje; quietud del desenlace.
rejected: Figura sobrenatural femenina, rostro en árbol y espirales de viento no descritos por la fuente.
Árbol monumental tropical, vegetación exuberante, grandes discos solares y escenografía monumental.
Rostros volumétricos, estatuas genéricas y falta de la carga de panela.

influence_by_act.entrada: Abrir la llanura y conservar contraste cromático; dos comerciantes y sus cargas, cuyas sombras de vasija expresan sed sin añadir vasijas reales.
influence_by_act.acto: Pasar de estatuas bajo un árbol mágico a transformación material de ropa en terreno, con los dos comerciantes pequeños y sin agente sobrenatural visible.
influence_by_act.huella: Condensar ámbar y azul en una panela con vacío de gota; sin paisaje ni cuerpos.

la-sed-da-los-civilizados.material_direction: Immersive photographed world made ENTIRELY of matte dyed CUT PAPER. Ground, distant hills and objects are broad physical sheets at different distances with visible air, overlaps, occlusion and cast shadows. No photoreal sand or soil, no painted flat collage. Characters are nearly flat brown SIDE-PROFILE cutouts with tiny eye incision and noses in silhouette, natural adult proportions, no modeled cheeks or glass eyeballs. Clothing uses a few broad folded sheets. Full bleed from inside the world; NO outer cardboard, board, model base, plinth, frame, tabletop or stage edge. Magic changes one material relation; no decorative sparkles, auras or glyphs.
la-sed-da-los-civilizados.paleta: arena, ocre panela, carbón, terracota y azul humo; luz seca lateral, sin disco solar
continuity_contract: Exactly TWO adult merchants, distinct, never twins. Neither is identified as a specific ethnic group by invented features.
Merchant 1: slimmer, short black hair and small moustache, plain wide straw-colored hat, OCHRE long-sleeved collared shirt, CHARCOAL long trousers, plain belt and brown closed shoes.
Merchant 2: stockier adult with short curly black hair, plain sand cloth cap with short brim, smoke-BLUE long-sleeved shirt, plain dark suspenders, TERRACOTTA long trousers and dark closed shoes.
Faces remain flat profile paper silhouettes with tiny eyes, no caricature. Whole body visible, subordinate to the land.
No deity or spirit, no people celebrating, no actual injury or corpse. Transformation is continuous material folding, not mutilation or imprisonment.

entrada.beat: La carga no puede darles lo que necesitan.
entrada.escena: 16:9 VERY DISTANT elevated landscape photograph of an IMMERSIVE CUT-PAPER WORLD, viewed from inside it. NOT a medium shot of people. Geometric constraint: the TWO adult merchants stand only at x70% and x82%, between y39% and y51%, each head-to-shoe height just ONE EIGHTH of the entire image (about 100 pixels in an 864px-tall image). Their small complete silhouettes, both cargo loads and entire jar-shaped shadows are contained in RIGHT THIRD, x64–96%, y37–66%. Vast EMPTY broad ochre paper ground sheets cover lower 40% and left 55%, reserved for website title. Camera high and far, sky and distant low blue-gray paper hills occupy upper third. Small merchant 1 has wide brim STRAW HAT, tiny dark moustache, ochre shirt, charcoal trousers. Small merchant 2 has a LOW SOFT SAND CAP WITH ONLY A SHORT FRONT VISOR, NO circular brim, blue shirt, dark suspenders, terracotta trousers. Both closed shoes, nearly flat profile faces, no sculpted faces or large figures. Exactly TWO small RECTANGULAR plain tied bundles at their feet, each partially exposing AMBER blocks of panela. Each bundle casts ONE narrow shadow connected DIRECTLY to its base, continuing diagonally behind it and widening at far end into silhouette of a ROUND-BELLIED WATER JAR, narrow neck and one handle. Jar shadows about 1.5 times bundle width; readable against plain ground, separate and fully inside image. The solid objects are ONLY rectangular sugar bundles; NO actual jar exists. Both men's ordinary short shadows faint and distinct from those two impossible cargo shadows, no merged shadow origins. Scene is a quiet pause, no gestures of power. Shadows of absent water containers express what sugar cannot provide. All surfaces broad matte dyed cut-paper sheets with fiber, real air and cast shadows at separated distances, no grainy real sand. No box, base, pedestal, tabletop, border, building, deity, tree, giant sun, water, duplicate object or decorative icon.
entrada.editorial_translation: Metáfora material y puesta en escena editorial; no nuevo episodio literal, vestuario fechado ni símbolo ancestral.

acto.beat: Los pliegues del viaje se quedan en la tierra.
acto.escena: 9:16 WIDE landscape scene in dry Utta plain at subdued late afternoon. Distant low hills and empty sky occupy upper third; broad ochre PAPER terrain with physical separated layers, no stage platform. At x37%,y39–59% the first adult merchant rests SEATED with knees bent, plain wide straw hat, tiny moustache, ochre shirt, charcoal trousers. At x65%,y44–63% the second adult rests CROUCHED with one knee low, short-brim sand cap, blue shirt, dark suspenders, terracotta trousers. Complete small bodies, each less than a quarter frame height, natural adult proportions, nearly flat brown profile faces; calm and still, heads slightly lowered, NO pain or injury. The two distinct postures remain readable. ONE impossible material transformation: broad lower folds of their trousers and shirt hems continue WITHOUT A BREAK into attached solid ROCK STRATA that spread into the ground around their resting feet. On the first figure charcoal and ochre folds become ONE taller irregular stone form; on second blue-gray and muted terracotta folds become ONE lower broader rock form. Clear continuity from each human's garment fold to its mineral fold to the terrain; no separate rock next to an unchanged person. Upper torsos, arms and heads remain fully clothed and intact as a poetic instant of metamorphosis, not corpses or people trapped in stone. All layers are matte cut paper with air gaps, shadows and occasional lifted edges. No rock rings enclosing people, no cairns, stacked monuments, pyramids, armor, amputations or trapped legs. Two small plain tied panela bundles rest beside them, one amber rectangular block visible at each opening, not multiplied loads. Lower THIRD empty quiet terrain for mobile title. No extra human, god, witch, face in tree, water, animal, sun disc, houses, forest, agave or decorative wind. Transformation belongs to the ground and garment folds; no beam or magic gesture.
acto.editorial_translation: Metáfora material y puesta en escena editorial; no nuevo episodio literal, vestuario fechado ni símbolo ancestral.

huella.beat: Toda la dulzura deja intacta la sed.
huella.escena: Square 1:1 SYMBOLIC CUT-PAPER SCULPTURE, a handmade paper representation of ONE squat rectangular AMBER PANELA brick, not a photograph of edible sugar. Full bleed muted INDIGO PAPER field. One slightly irregular brick lies obliquely at center, roughly 58% frame width, large quiet space around. Its TOP is ONE broad MATTE OCHRE PAPER SHEET with clearly visible long paper fibers and a few clean knife-cut edges; absolutely NO sugar crystals, granular crust, crumbs, mottled food texture or caramel gloss. Its side thickness consists of FOUR broad offset brown/amber paper layers with actual narrow air gaps and cast shadows. A large DRY TEARDROP-SHAPED HOLE passes through ALL layers, revealing plain indigo background, not water. At the hole's edge, stepped paper strata remain clear and separated with their own small shadows; a few subtly irregular torn fibers, not digitally smooth printed drop. One connected block around the hole, not separate pieces. The missing drop is negative space, not blue fill, logo, engraving or surface drawing. Solid sweet matter represented by paper frames the absence of water. No wrapper, typography, cord, bowl, horizon, people, terrain, extra brick, table edge, plinth, display board, studio or outer support. Grazing side light reveals actual cut edges and volumetric paper layers. Editorial symbolic object, not food photography or product advertisement.
